name: baselane-mods
description: Claude Code mods, checked and pinned. Browse them at https://mods.baselane.sh

plugins.name: achievements
plugins.description: Unlocks eight badges once each (first session, first green test run, 100 and 1,000 tool calls, 7-day streak, 10 blocked calls, a 2 hour session, night owl), with a toast and /achievements.

plugins.name: agent-firewall
plugins.description: A live pane of every tool call the agent makes: green when it ran, red when it was blocked, with counters. Open it with /firewall.

plugins.name: auto-format
plugins.description: Runs your project's own formatter on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has a formatter config, and tells Claude to re-read the file.

plugins.name: big-diff-nudge
plugins.description: Suggests splitting the change once your edits added or removed more than 500 lines since the last git commit. A successful commit resets the count.

plugins.name: branch-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, refreshed after each Bash call and file edit.

plugins.name: branches
plugins.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list. Never deletes.

plugins.name: break-nudge
plugins.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

plugins.name: caveman-mode
plugins.description: Prose in short caveman speech ("Fix bug. Test pass."), still accurate. Code and commands stay exact.

plugins.name: changelog
plugins.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown.

plugins.name: clippy
plugins.description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.

plugins.name: code-only
plugins.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

plugins.name: command-pack
plugins.description: Every slash command in one mod: /receipt, /standup, /changelog, /pr-description and /handoff.

plugins.name: commit-msg
plugins.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing.

plugins.name: commit-nudge
plugins.description: Suggests a commit at turn end after 8 or more file edits since the last git commit. One toast per batch of edits; a successful git commit resets the count.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with a 10 cell bar of the context window used, yellow from 60 percent, red from 80.

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, imperative, under 72 characters.

plugins.name: cost-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

plugins.name: cost-pane
plugins.description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.

plugins.name: ctx-nudge
plugins.description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

plugins.name: curl-pipe-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a download is piped into a shell or interpreter (curl | sh, wget -O- | bash, bash <(curl ...)).

plugins.name: daily-spend
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

plugins.name: debug-print-nudge
plugins.description: At turn end, one toast naming the count of console.log, print(, debugger and dbg! lines your edits added this turn. Only code files count.

plugins.name: dev-band
plugins.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files, wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

plugins.name: diff-stats
plugins.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

plugins.name: docs-nudge
plugins.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

plugins.name: eli5-mode
plugins.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

plugins.name: env-exfil-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.

plugins.name: error-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

plugins.name: file-links
plugins.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

plugins.name: focus-pack
plugins.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

plugins.name: fun-pack
plugins.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

plugins.name: git-pane
plugins.description: A live side pane with the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. It refreshes after git commands and file edits. Open it with /git.

plugins.name: gitignore-check
plugins.description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked.

plugins.name: gitmoji-commits
plugins.description: Commit messages start with the matching gitmoji (✨ feat, 🐛 fix). Composes with conventional-commits: emoji goes before the type.

plugins.name: guard-essentials
plugins.description: Asks only before harsh or disaster commands: destructive infra, git and SQL, piping downloads into a shell, sudo, leaking or committing secrets. The quiet choice for daily work.

plugins.name: guard-pack
plugins.description: Every Baselane guard in one mod.

plugins.name: haiku-commits
plugins.description: Commit messages get a normal conventional-commit first line, then a 5-7-5 haiku about the change in the body.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path.

plugins.name: hotspots
plugins.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, with change counts. Read-only.

plugins.name: infra-guard
plugins.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

plugins.name: junior-mode
plugins.description: Explains each step and why, and defines jargon once, for a learner.

plugins.name: latte-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt that counts the session cost in lattes. Set the latte price in the plugin options.

plugins.name: lifecycle-pack
plugins.description: Every Baselane lifecycle mod in one: auto-format, long-run and input pushes, and the session journal.

plugins.name: loc
plugins.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only.

plugins.name: lockfile-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a lockfile is written or edited by hand; the package manager should change it.

plugins.name: lockfile-nudge
plugins.description: At turn end, one toast when dependencies in package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod changed and neither the matching lockfile was edited nor an install command ran.

plugins.name: long-run-notify
plugins.description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when a Bash command ran longer than a threshold (60 seconds by default). Sends the project name and the seconds only. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

plugins.name: migration-nudge
plugins.description: At turn end, one toast when a schema file changed (schema.prisma, models.py, SQL under schema/, a drizzle schema) and no migration file was created this session.

plugins.name: model-badge
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the current model name and the context percent (opus-4-1 · 62%).

plugins.name: mood-ring
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

plugins.name: night-owl
plugins.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

plugins.name: no-em-dash
plugins.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

plugins.name: no-sycophancy
plugins.description: No flattery or filler. Disagreement is stated plainly, with the reason.

plugins.name: no-verify-guard
plugins.description: Asks before git hooks are skipped (--no-verify, commit -n, HUSKY=0, core.hooksPath=/dev/null).

plugins.name: ntfy-notify
plugins.description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when Claude Code needs your input. The message is generic. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

plugins.name: nudge-pack
plugins.description: Every Baselane turn-end reminder in one mod.

plugins.name: package-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a new dependency is installed (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go, gem) and names the packages.

plugins.name: path-jail
plugins.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

plugins.name: pirate-mode
plugins.description: Talks like a pirate in prose, never inside code, commands or file contents.

plugins.name: plain-english
plugins.description: Writes in ASD-STE-100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple words.

plugins.name: port-watch
plugins.description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Adds /pr-description: title, summary, diff totals and a test plan stub for the current branch against main or master.

plugins.name: prod-db-guard
plugins.description: Asks before destructive SQL runs in a command: TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE.

plugins.name: protect-main
plugins.description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master.

plugins.name: quality-pack
plugins.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: type check after TypeScript edits, lockfile after dependency edits, and a split suggestion past 500 changed lines.

plugins.name: receipt
plugins.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

plugins.name: render-pack
plugins.description: Every rendering mod in one: diff-stats bars on Edit and Write rows, and file-links in Claude's replies.

plugins.name: reply-language
plugins.description: Answers in the language you set (English by default). Code, identifiers and commands stay as they are.

plugins.name: repo-pack
plugins.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches.

plugins.name: secret-commit-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file.

plugins.name: secret-filename-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.

plugins.name: secret-output-guard
plugins.description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.

plugins.name: security-mode
plugins.description: Checks each change for injection, secrets, authorization and unsafe input, and states the risks it checked.

plugins.name: session-clock
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the wall clock and how long the session has run (14:05 · 1h 12m).

plugins.name: session-journal
plugins.description: Appends one line per session end (time, directory, reason) to ~/.claude/journal.log.

plugins.name: shakespeare-mode
plugins.description: Prose in Early Modern English flair. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

plugins.name: sounds-minimal
plugins.description: Very short, quiet clicks and ticks for a subtle signal: a tick when tests pass, two low ticks when they fail, a click when a call is blocked, a soft tick when a turn ends.

plugins.name: sounds-nature
plugins.description: Soft nature sounds: a bird chirp when tests pass, a plunk into water when they fail, a gust of wind when a call is blocked, a water drop when a turn ends.

plugins.name: sounds-office
plugins.description: Quiet office sounds: a soft click when tests pass, a low thud when they fail, paper when a call is blocked.

plugins.name: sounds-retro
plugins.description: 8-bit sounds: a coin when tests pass, a buzz when they fail, a chime when a turn ends.

plugins.name: sounds-scifi
plugins.description: Sci-fi console sounds: a beep when tests pass, an alarm when they fail, a warp when a turn ends.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

plugins.name: stats-pack
plugins.description: Every Baselane stats mod in one: /wrapped, streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

plugins.name: ste-mode
plugins.description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

plugins.name: streaks
plugins.description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

plugins.name: sudo-guard
plugins.description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

plugins.name: tdd-mode
plugins.description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

plugins.name: team-pack
plugins.description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.

plugins.name: terse-mode
plugins.description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

plugins.name: test-reminder
plugins.description: Reminds you at turn end when source files changed but no test command ran since.

plugins.name: todo-nudge
plugins.description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

plugins.name: todo-pane
plugins.description: A live side pane of the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files (git grep), grouped by file and capped at 30. It refreshes after file edits while open. Open it with /todo-pane.

plugins.name: todos
plugins.description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only.

plugins.name: tool-counter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with your tool calls this session, the top three by tool (Bash 41 · Edit 18 · Read 12).

plugins.name: typecheck-nudge
plugins.description: At turn end, one toast when .ts or .tsx files were edited and no type check (tsc, vue-tsc, a typecheck script or a build) ran since the last edit.

plugins.name: wrapped
plugins.description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

plugins.name: yoda-mode
plugins.description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.
